A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DESIGNER study. All 34 pages of each, including Appendices A–K, support comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v4 reports original dataset analyses, supervised fine-tuning results, scaling and ablation experiments, and additional mathematical benchmark results in Appendix I.

after.justification: v6 retains the study’s original dataset analyses and model experiments, including the results in Appendix I.

M1.justification: The extraction, graph deduplication, top-five retrieval, LLM selection, question generation, and response-synthesis procedures remain unchanged. The expanded discussion of alternative response models does not introduce an implemented method change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same question bank, book and web corpora, 75-discipline coverage, and evaluation benchmarks. GSM8K and MATH-500 are already present in v4 Appendix I; no new evaluation population or task is introduced.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 4 retain OpenThoughts3, Nemotron-Post-Training-v1, WebInstruct (Full), and NaturalReasoning. The official Qwen3/Llama comparators and Table 5 ablation variants also remain unchanged; the exemplar comparator receives a clearer description.

E3.justification: The zero-shot evaluation, settings in Tables 11–13, 304,181-instance baseline and ablation comparisons, and 282,857-instance matched source-corpus comparison are retained. The additional retrieval explanation does not establish a changed experimental procedure.

E4.justification: The same component ablations, full-corpus control, scaling tests, source-quality comparison, and data-quality analyses appear in both versions. Appendix analyses and examples are retained. The added explanation of small ranking-ablation effects provides interpretation rather than new analytical evidence.

E5.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same independent-rollout, mean accuracy, standard deviation, and self-consistency reporting practices. Table 13 still specifies ten rollouts for both GPQA benchmarks; no additional runs or statistical procedures are reported.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends, and table rankings remain unchanged, including Appendix I. For example, full DLR-Book SFT on Qwen3-8B retains 69.39±1.87 on GPQA-Diamond. The more categorical ablation summary describes within-setting wins already shown in v4 Table 5.

T1.justification: The graph-based deduplication definitions and Algorithm 1, cosine-similarity retrieval formula, and Appendix G diversity-metric formulas are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The central claims about reusable Design Logics, controllable multidisciplinary synthesis, the two datasets, and improved SFT reasoning are retained. The revised abstract incorporates explanations already present in v4’s introduction without substantively changing the contribution’s scope.

C2.justification: Section 5.6 newly explains limited ranking-ablation effects as preserving the overall framework while selecting suboptimal logics. Section 3.4 explicitly discusses using other response models, and Section 5.5 calls the source-quality gap 'small' instead of 'negligible'. Appendix I’s qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 describes choosing an exemplar from five retrieved questions; v6 explicitly specifies semantic coarse ranking followed by LLM selection, matching DESIGNER. Figure 4 additionally identifies full-dataset distributions. Existing hyperparameters, prompts, and resource-release statements are retained.

R1.justification: The cited research and substantive related-work comparisons remain unchanged. Replacing 'doc-centric' with 'document-centric' and reiterating the focus on question synthesis do not establish new research positioning.

P1.justification: v6 revises the abstract and selected introductory, processing, and ablation passages, standardizes 'Design Logic' terminology, and changes the preprint header to an ICLR publication header. The section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes 'Exam Questions' to 'Generate Exam Questions', and Figure 4 clarifies its caption. Tables 3 and 5 revise bold/underline emphasis for leading results. Spacing and text flow change modestly; the figures and tables retain their underlying content and structure.

improvement.justification: v6 clarifies the matched exemplar control and Figure 4’s dataset scope, while improving result highlighting in Tables 3 and 5. These changes make the existing evidence easier to assess. The added explanation for small ablation effects remains untested, so the supported overall gain is limited to clearer documentation and presentation.
